# Projects

Small builds and experiments from Home PC.

- Lantern: hardware monitoring and window restore work.
- Paperbird: pocket planners and a small launch experiment.

Open the folders for source, notes and design frames.

# Lantern

A compact hardware monitoring panel for Home PC and Work PC.

## Next pass

- Keep the labels stable as readings move.
- Review keyboard focus.
- Add the restore regression to the release checklist.

![Hardware panel](design/hardware-panel.png)

# Release checklist

- [x] Reproduce the restore bug
- [x] Add the focused regression
- [x] Check file previews
- [ ] Review keyboard navigation
- [ ] Capture the finished hardware panel

# Documents

Research notes, project handoffs and launch planning from Work PC.

Start with the research digest or the Paperbird launch brief.

# Offline queues

Keep pending work visible during a disconnect. An acknowledgement settles the item. Repeated submissions keep the same idempotency key.

## Experiment

Disconnect briefly while a result arrives and compare recovery behaviour.

# Weekly research digest

## Useful findings

Focused tests made the restore bug easier to reproduce. File previews should retain their last accepted content across panel moves.

## Next experiment

Compare the queue inspector with its detail pane open by default.

# Paperbird launch brief

A pocket planner for small daily wins.

## First batch

Use recycled packaging and a cream cover. Compare the single planner with a planner and refill bundle. Photograph the samples in daylight.

The regression covers an empty secondary screen. Review focus after closing the viewer and returning to the file list.
